date_oriented_score.interpretation: Strong deterministic boundary-test milestone, but not an exhaustive protocol-correctness proof and not a DATE accelerator result.

identity_audit.contract_to_runner_binding: ASYMMETRIC: runner pins the contract and five frozen inputs, while the contract does not pin the runner, producer validator, or VCS executable SHA
identity_audit.receipt_binding: Producer receipt pins contract, source bindings, runner, producer validator and nine run artifacts at receipt generation time.
identity_audit.receipt_self_binding: INCOMPLETE: no detached producer receipt checksum/completion manifest exists, and the producer validator does not refuse overwriting an existing receipt when called directly.

functional_audit.oracle_independence_boundary: The testbench recomputes signed accumulation procedurally for every packed lane, independent of the RTL reduction tree, but it is still an in-testbench oracle derived from the same packed stimulus rather than an external implementation.

proof_boundary.admitted_statement: The exact frozen RTL passed the enumerated deterministic legal and malformed traces under VCS/SVA.
proof_boundary.forbidden_statement: The protocol is exhaustively proven correct for arbitrary traffic, backpressure, reset timing, fault combinations, or temporal sequences.

P0.finding: Six legal groups plus five single-fault attacks establish those traces only. They do not cover arbitrary multi-event groups, ready/valid interleavings, reset boundaries, combined faults, or long sticky duration, and no formal protocol-property proof is present.
P0.impact: Blocks any DATE-level claim of exhaustive protocol correctness or any attempt to use directed cover hits as a substitute for constrained-random and formal evidence.
P0.minimal_fix: Add a frozen-seed constrained-random VCS campaign with cross coverage over legal/illegal causes, group length, stalls and reset phase, plus commercial formal proofs for handshake conservation, accepted-malformed-to-fault, sticky-until-reset, interface closure and output stability.

P1.finding: The official run is internally consistent but has no RUN_COMPLETE, output manifest or completion seal; its directory and eleven top-level files remain writable.
P1.impact: The path suffix 'sealed' is not independently supported by filesystem or manifest evidence.
P1.minimal_fix: In a new additive seal directory, snapshot inputs and verification code, hash every admitted output, add a completion marker and make the evidence tree read-only; do not mutate this production run.

P1.finding: The runner pins the contract and five frozen design inputs, but the contract does not pin the runner, producer validator or VCS executable SHA.
P1.impact: The launch recipe and checker identity are bound only after the run by a mutable receipt.
P1.minimal_fix: Use a pre-run launch contract that pins runner, validator and exact VCS launcher SHA, then snapshot all three into the sealed run.

P1.finding: The producer receipt binds many inputs and outputs, but it has no producer-side detached digest or manifest, and the validator can overwrite an existing receipt when invoked directly. Its four tamper cases mutate contract objects only, not receipt/run self-binding.
P1.impact: Receipt regeneration or coordinated receipt/artifact editing is not fail-closed at the producer evidence layer.
P1.minimal_fix: Refuse receipt overwrite, emit a detached receipt SHA from a separate sealing step, validate the whole run manifest, and add receipt/run-artifact tamper attacks.

P1.finding: Each legal group has one event and each malformed class is exercised once after a reset. There are no combined causes, multi-event accumulation faults, outstanding-output fault interactions, randomized stalls, or reset/fault boundary sequences.
P1.impact: The current semantics may not expose ordering and state interaction bugs.
P1.minimal_fix: Extend VCS with deterministic corner sequences and constrained-random temporal campaigns while preserving exact seed and transaction ledgers.

P2.finding: The testbench explicitly checks five repeated stall cycles, while the SVA cover reports six matches because the pre-check output-valid cycle is also stalled.
P2.impact: No functional failure, but the paper/rebuttal wording should distinguish five checked repeat cycles from six sampled cover hits.
P2.minimal_fix: State both numbers explicitly or gate the cover with a dedicated stall-repeat phase counter.

P2.finding: All 96 lanes are checked, but the oracle is procedural SystemVerilog inside the same testbench and consumes the same packed masks and weights.
P2.impact: A shared stimulus packing mistake could evade both drive and expected-value construction.
P2.minimal_fix: Add a separately implemented Python or C++ bit-vector oracle with frozen vectors and compare its per-lane expected outputs.
